objective: Trade only explicitly defined Wyckoff range events with contextual confirmation.

required: Identify the trading range boundaries and current phase.
Mark prior support, resistance, and observable tests.
State whether evidence supports accumulation, distribution, or uncertainty.

requirements: Price trades below defined range support.
Price closes back inside the range.
A subsequent test shows reduced downside progress or rejection.
Entry, stop, target, and invalidation are defined before entry.
exclusions: High-impact event is inside the configured pre-trade window.
Required reward-to-risk or risk limit is not met.

requirements: Price trades above defined range resistance.
Price closes back inside the range.
Supply evidence appears on a later test.
Entry, stop, target, and invalidation are defined before entry.
exclusions: High-impact event is inside the configured pre-trade window.
Required reward-to-risk or risk limit is not met.
